name: g_hitFlag
notes: Per player: 1 if Hit_Deliver ran for this frame's shot (any entry, level hits too); reset per player at the start of Hit_Task 0x00404570 [agent:autoplay]

name: g_hitEntryCount
notes: Hit entry count; reset at the start of each player's pass in Hit_Task, so 0 after the frame unless P2 hit [agent:autoplay]

name: g_hitKeys
notes: Sorted in place by Hit_SortByDepth; [0].index (0x0059ECDC) = the delivered (nearest) entry; still valid at the next Input_Poll [agent:autoplay]

name: g_hitEntries
notes: +0x24 node/obj, +0x28 object (0 = level), +0x2C flags; read by the auto player as shot feedback [agent:autoplay]

name: g_gameMode
notes: 3 title, 4 after start on the title (waits for a trigger pull, then 6), 5 attract demo, 6 game, 7 game over, 9 (after the title, alternates with 3 every ~600 frames when no credits), 16 boot [agent:autoplay; 4/9 meaning hypothesis]
